views.not_found_message: The page you were looking for isn't here. It may have moved when {forum} was reorganised, or the link may be mistyped.
views.gone_message: This page no longer exists on {forum}, on purpose.

api.type_invalid: Choose exact, prefix or regular expression.
api.note_long: The note can be at most 255 characters.
api.source_required: Enter the address to redirect (at most 1000 characters).
api.source_path: The address must be a path starting with /, or a full http(s) address.
api.source_home: The home page can't be redirected.
api.source_reserved: Addresses under /api, /admin, /assets and the log-in pages are never redirected.
api.regex_home: That regular expression matches your home page; make it more specific.
api.duplicate: There is already a redirect for this address.
api.lookup_invalid: Lookups need a regular expression whose first group captures the old id.
api.target_invalid: The target must be a path on this forum starting with a single /, or a full http(s) address.
api.target_captures: $1 and the like only work with regular expressions.
api.external_off: This sends visitors to another site. Turn on "Allow another site" if that's what you want.
api.external_host: The other site's address must be written out in full; a $1 can't stand in for its host.
api.loop: This would send visitors in a loop back to the same address.
api.run_unknown: That Importer run no longer exists.
api.csv_size: Paste or choose a CSV file (at most 2 MB).

modes.missing: Only if the forum has no page there

test.label: Test an address
test.invalid: Enter a path starting with /, or a full address.
test.reserved: Detour never touches /api, /admin, /assets or the log-in pages.
test.missing: If Flarum has no page there: rule #{id} answers {status} →

redirects.empty: No redirects yet. Add one, start from the 404 log, or install a migration preset.

modal.type_help_exact: The whole address, ignoring case and a trailing slash. Add ?a=1 to match only that exact query (any other parameter, such as ?fbclid=, makes it a different address).
modal.type_help_prefix: The address and everything below it: /old matches /old/anything, and the rest is added to the target.
modal.type_help_regex: A regular expression over the decoded path and query, case-insensitive. Use $1, $2 … in the target.
modal.target_help: A path on this forum (/d/12) or a full address on another site.
modal.target_help_prefix: The rest of the old address is added to this: /old/a → /new/a.
modal.target_help_regex: Use $1, $2 … for the groups the expression captured.
modal.lookup_help: The first group is the old id (or name); Detour finds the discussion, post, tag or member it became.
modal.run_help: The run number in the Importer, whose id map the lookup goes through.
modal.external_help: Detour only ever sends visitors to the site written here.
modal.mode_help_always: Checked before Flarum, even where the forum has a page.
modal.mode_help_missing: Only when Flarum has no page at that address. Safest for old addresses that might clash with Flarum's own.

missing.help: Addresses people asked for that don't exist, one row each with how often and from where. Search engine bots and missing images are left out (see the settings).
missing.empty: Nothing logged. Every address people asked for existed.
missing.referrers: {count, plural, one {# referring page} other {# referring pages}}

presets.help: Moved here from another forum? Install its preset and the old addresses (topics, posts, forums, members) go to what they became. Preset rules only act where Flarum has no page, so they can never take one of yours.
presets.importer_help: Imported with the Importer? Choose its run so old ids are mapped to the new ones. The Importer keeps no map of posts, so links to single posts can only be followed when ids were kept; the discussion links still work.
presets.importer_on: The Importer's own old-address redirects are turned on, and they answer before these presets. Turn them off in the Importer if you want Detour's hit counts and 404 log for those addresses.
presets.addresses: {count, plural, one {# kind of address} other {# kinds of address}}

server.title: Does your server pass old addresses to Flarum?
server.help: Many servers answer addresses ending in .php, .html, .asp or .xml themselves, so no Flarum extension ever sees them. Check before relying on rules for them.
server.blocked: answered by the web server, never reaches Flarum
server.fix_php: To redirect old .php addresses (phpBB, vBulletin, MyBB, SMF), change one line in the nginx block that passes .php files to PHP: its try_files becomes
server.fix_php_help: Existing .php files still run as before; only missing ones go to Flarum. Never add a separate block for .php that serves files directly: that would hand out source code.
server.fix: To redirect {exts} addresses, add this to the site's nginx server block, above any other block for those types:
server.fix_help: Then reload nginx and check again. Apache with Flarum's .htaccess needs nothing.

csv.export_help: Every redirect, in a file you can edit in a spreadsheet and import again here or on another forum.
csv.import_help: Detour's own export, or one redirect per line: old address, new address, and optionally 301, 302 or 410. Every row is checked like the form; bad rows are listed and skipped.
csv.result_check: {created} would be imported, {failed} would be skipped.
csv.truncated: Only the first 10,000 rows were read.

settings.friendly_page_help: Instead of Flarum's bare message: a search box filled with the words from the address, and discussions that match them.
settings.suggestions_help: Only discussions a guest can see; refreshed every ten minutes.
settings.page_message_help: Plain text. Leave empty for the default.
settings.log_help: One row per address with its hits, last seen and referrers; never one row per visit.
settings.ignore_bots_label: Leave bots out of the log
settings.ignore_bots_help: Turn off for a while after a migration to see which old addresses search engines still crawl.
settings.ignore_paths_help: One per line; an address containing any of these is not logged (vulnerability scanners mostly).
settings.max_rows_help: Above this, the least-hit addresses are dropped first.
settings.retention_days_help: Addresses not seen for this long are dropped.
